infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: KavachAI needs continuous location to verify you are in the active disruption zone and protect your payout from fraud.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KavachAI needs your location to confirm you are in the disruption zone when a payout is triggered.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KavachAI needs your camera to take a live verification selfie when a payout is triggered. This protects your account from fraud.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: KavachAI reads your accelerometer and gyroscope to confirm you are actively riding during a disruption. This prevents fraudulent claims.
